posts.text: On World Environment Day, my best wishes to everyone. Let us keep nurturing our planet and applaud the conservation efforts happening across India. Together, we can build a sustainable future for generations to come.
posts.caption: On World Environment Day, my best wishes to everyone. Let us keep nurturing our planet and applaud the conservation efforts happening across India. Together, we can build a sustainable future for generations to come.

posts.text: PM congratulated Dr. R. Balasubramaniam and Dr. Joram Aniya on being appointed as Full-time Members of NITI Aayog. Their expertise will strengthen India's development agenda and drive policy innovation.
posts.caption: PM congratulated Dr. R. Balasubramaniam and Dr. Joram Aniya on being appointed as Full-time Members of NITI Aayog. Their expertise will strengthen India's development agenda and drive policy innovation.

posts.text: The Delhi fire tragedy is deeply saddening. We are ensuring a city-wide crackdown against all establishments violating fire safety norms. Non-compliant premises will be sealed and those responsible prosecuted. Safety of citizens is paramount.
posts.caption: The Delhi fire tragedy is deeply saddening. We are ensuring a city-wide crackdown against all establishments violating fire safety norms. Non-compliant premises will be sealed and those responsible prosecuted. Safety of citizens is paramount.

posts.text: The RBI has held the repo rate at 5.25% amid rising global uncertainty. While this signals caution, the government must do more to address the real concerns of common people — rising prices and unemployment.
posts.caption: The RBI has held the repo rate at 5.25% amid rising global uncertainty. While this signals caution, the government must do more to address the real concerns of common people — rising prices and unemployment.

posts.text: Uttar Pradesh continues to set benchmarks in development and law & order. Our commitment to building a New UP remains unwavering. The state's industrial growth and infrastructure transformation speak for themselves.
posts.caption: Uttar Pradesh continues to set benchmarks in development and law & order. Our commitment to building a New UP remains unwavering. The state's industrial growth and infrastructure transformation speak for themselves.

posts.text: 21 people died in the Delhi hotel fire including 12 foreign nationals. We will launch a city-wide crackdown against all guest houses and establishments operating in violation of fire safety norms. This cannot be tolerated.
posts.caption: 21 people died in the Delhi hotel fire including 12 foreign nationals. We will launch a city-wide crackdown against all guest houses and establishments operating in violation of fire safety norms. This cannot be tolerated.

posts.text: Deeply concerned about the Delhi hotel fire that claimed lives of foreign nationals. We are in touch with the embassies concerned and extending all necessary assistance. India's relationship with the US is of immense importance — built on substance, not symbolism.
posts.caption: Deeply concerned about the Delhi hotel fire that claimed lives of foreign nationals. We are in touch with the embassies concerned and extending all necessary assistance. India's relationship with the US is of immense importance — built on substance, not symbolism.

posts.text: Inaugurated the Farmers' Training Centre and Common Facility Centre for Agro Processing at Badepalli, Yadgir district, Karnataka. This facility will strengthen rural livelihoods and agricultural value chains in Kalyana Karnataka.
posts.caption: Inaugurated the Farmers' Training Centre and Common Facility Centre for Agro Processing at Badepalli, Yadgir district, Karnataka. This facility will strengthen rural livelihoods and agricultural value chains in Kalyana Karnataka.

posts.text: Being an entrepreneur is my dream job as it tests one's tenacity. With a $117 billion valuation, the Adani Group continues to drive India's infrastructure and energy expansion. Our 6 lakh crore investment blueprint across aviation, clean energy and advanced manufacturing is on track.
posts.caption: Being an entrepreneur is my dream job as it tests one's tenacity. With a $117 billion valuation, the Adani Group continues to drive India's infrastructure and energy expansion. Our 6 lakh crore investment blueprint across aviation, clean energy and advanced manufacturing is on track.

posts.text: We have no hesitation in believing we can build the businesses of the future. Reliance has committed 10 lakh crore to AI-ready data centres. I also announced a 151 crore grant to ICT Mumbai, honouring my mentor Professor Man Mohan Sharma.
posts.caption: We have no hesitation in believing we can build the businesses of the future. Reliance has committed 10 lakh crore to AI-ready data centres. I also announced a 151 crore grant to ICT Mumbai, honouring my mentor Professor Man Mohan Sharma.

posts.text: The legacy of the Tata Group endures — built on trust, integrity, and nation-building. Our commitment to India's progress through innovation, philanthropy, and sustainable development remains as strong as ever.
posts.caption: The legacy of the Tata Group endures — built on trust, integrity, and nation-building. Our commitment to India's progress through innovation, philanthropy, and sustainable development remains as strong as ever.

posts.text: On World Environment Day, let us pledge to protect our planet for future generations. India's conservation efforts — from tiger reserves to renewable energy — show what collective commitment can achieve.
posts.caption: On World Environment Day, let us pledge to protect our planet for future generations. India's conservation efforts — from tiger reserves to renewable energy — show what collective commitment can achieve.

posts.text: There are concepts where pieces of AI companies could be given to the American public, where the American public essentially becomes a partner with the companies. I have spoken to all of them. There's something very interesting about it.
posts.caption: There are concepts where pieces of AI companies could be given to the American public, where the American public essentially becomes a partner with the companies. I have spoken to all of them. There's something very interesting about it.

posts.text: I remain committed to serving my constituents in Richmond. As the Conservative Party rebuilds, the values of fiscal responsibility, innovation, and opportunity must remain at our core. The work continues.
posts.caption: I remain committed to serving my constituents in Richmond. As the Conservative Party rebuilds, the values of fiscal responsibility, innovation, and opportunity must remain at our core. The work continues.

posts.text: If you're going to use energy for data centers, pay for your own energy rather than passing the bill onto the consumer. If you use the water, pay for it. That's not too much to ask. But banning data centers? That would be a terrible idea. We need leadership in the sectors of the future.
posts.caption: If you're going to use energy for data centers, pay for your own energy rather than passing the bill onto the consumer. If you use the water, pay for it. That's not too much to ask. But banning data centers? That would be a terrible idea. We need leadership in the sectors of the future.

posts.text: Proud to support the administration's efforts to bring AI benefits to all Americans. The conversation around government partnerships with tech companies is an important one for our nation's future.
posts.caption: Proud to support the administration's efforts to bring AI benefits to all Americans. The conversation around government partnerships with tech companies is an important one for our nation's future.

posts.text: We are focused on ensuring transparency and accountability across the intelligence community. The release of classified records is essential — the American people deserve to know the truth.
posts.caption: We are focused on ensuring transparency and accountability across the intelligence community. The release of classified records is essential — the American people deserve to know the truth.

posts.text: The AI policy landscape is evolving rapidly. Working with the administration on responsible AI development that keeps America at the frontier while ensuring the benefits reach every American household.
posts.caption: The AI policy landscape is evolving rapidly. Working with the administration on responsible AI development that keeps America at the frontier while ensuring the benefits reach every American household.

posts.text: At the World Bank, we continue to drive investment in emerging economies. The intersection of AI, infrastructure, and development finance presents unprecedented opportunities for global growth and poverty reduction.
posts.caption: At the World Bank, we continue to drive investment in emerging economies. The intersection of AI, infrastructure, and development finance presents unprecedented opportunities for global growth and poverty reduction.

posts.text: Hosting President Zelenskyy, President Macron and Chancellor Merz in London on Sunday. We will continue our close coordination on supporting Ukraine and increasing pressure on Russia's war effort. Russia is facing military, economic, and strategic failure.
posts.caption: Hosting President Zelenskyy, President Macron and Chancellor Merz in London on Sunday. We will continue our close coordination on supporting Ukraine and increasing pressure on Russia's war effort. Russia is facing military, economic, and strategic failure.

posts.text: Australia continues to strengthen its partnerships in the Indo-Pacific. Our commitment to a free and open region, underpinned by strong alliances and economic resilience, remains unwavering.
posts.caption: Australia continues to strengthen its partnerships in the Indo-Pacific. Our commitment to a free and open region, underpinned by strong alliances and economic resilience, remains unwavering.

posts.text: We have always advocated for direct negotiations between Ukraine and the Kremlin. I believe it is Ukraine and Russia who can build both a ceasefire and a peace plan. It is the Europeans who can help with this. Meeting Zelenskyy, Starmer and Merz in London Sunday.
posts.caption: We have always advocated for direct negotiations between Ukraine and the Kremlin. I believe it is Ukraine and Russia who can build both a ceasefire and a peace plan. It is the Europeans who can help with this. Meeting Zelenskyy, Starmer and Merz in London Sunday.

posts.text: Dubai continues to lead in innovation and AI adoption. Our vision is to make the UAE the most future-ready nation on earth. The investments we are making today in technology and infrastructure will define the next century of progress.
posts.caption: Dubai continues to lead in innovation and AI adoption. Our vision is to make the UAE the most future-ready nation on earth. The investments we are making today in technology and infrastructure will define the next century of progress.

posts.text: What are the odds looking like? The driverless robotaxi era is here. The AI agent factory will convert electricity into tokens and tokens into revenue. The future is autonomous.
posts.caption: What are the odds looking like? The driverless robotaxi era is here. The AI agent factory will convert electricity into tokens and tokens into revenue. The future is autonomous.

posts.text: Meta Business Agent is now available globally — our first paid AI agent product. Businesses can use it across WhatsApp, Messenger, and Instagram. We're starting to see the promise of AI that understands our personal context, including our history, interests, and relationships.
posts.caption: Meta Business Agent is now available globally — our first paid AI agent product. Businesses can use it across WhatsApp, Messenger, and Instagram. We're starting to see the promise of AI that understands our personal context, including our history, interests, and relationships.

posts.text: Here's how we're helping you get more done with Gemini. We've transitioned from AI that simply assists you, to agents that can independently navigate complex tasks across your entire workflow. The agentic era has arrived at Google.
posts.caption: Here's how we're helping you get more done with Gemini. We've transitioned from AI that simply assists you, to agents that can independently navigate complex tasks across your entire workflow. The agentic era has arrived at Google.

posts.text: The goal is to deliver unmetered intelligence to every home and every desk. Can everyone operate at the frontier with their frontier intelligence? That is so important. We want to make sure AI empowers and adds real value to human endeavor and broad economic growth!
posts.caption: The goal is to deliver unmetered intelligence to every home and every desk. Can everyone operate at the frontier with their frontier intelligence? That is so important. We want to make sure AI empowers and adds real value to human endeavor and broad economic growth!

posts.text: I would love to see money out of politics in general. That would be a great thing to happen. We've discussed with the administration how the American public could benefit from the success of AI. I have no plans to make financial contributions toward this year's elections.
posts.caption: I would love to see money out of politics in general. That would be a great thing to happen. We've discussed with the administration how the American public could benefit from the success of AI. I have no plans to make financial contributions toward this year's elections.

posts.text: WWDC 2026 begins June 8. This is my final keynote as CEO before stepping into the Executive Chairman role in September. We're ready to show the world what Apple Intelligence can truly do — a rebuilt Siri, iOS 27, and so much more. See you Monday.
posts.caption: WWDC 2026 begins June 8. This is my final keynote as CEO before stepping into the Executive Chairman role in September. We're ready to show the world what Apple Intelligence can truly do — a rebuilt Siri, iOS 27, and so much more. See you Monday.

posts.text: Business is booming, and Korea is doing very well. My partners here are very important to me. Our new products — Vera Rubin, RTX Spark — will reinvent the PC for the AI era. Compute is revenue. The Agent Factory converts electricity into tokens, and tokens into revenue.
posts.caption: Business is booming, and Korea is doing very well. My partners here are very important to me. Our new products — Vera Rubin, RTX Spark — will reinvent the PC for the AI era. Compute is revenue. The Agent Factory converts electricity into tokens, and tokens into revenue.

posts.text: India's digital public infrastructure — Aadhaar, UPI, DigiLocker — continues to transform lives. As AI becomes the next platform shift, India has a unique opportunity to build population-scale AI systems that are inclusive and affordable.
posts.caption: India's digital public infrastructure — Aadhaar, UPI, DigiLocker — continues to transform lives. As AI becomes the next platform shift, India has a unique opportunity to build population-scale AI systems that are inclusive and affordable.

posts.text: AI systems are improving rapidly, and alongside incredible benefits to science and medicine, there is a real possibility that knowledge barriers preventing bad actors from obtaining biological weapons will erode. Congress must act on synthetic DNA screening.
posts.caption: AI systems are improving rapidly, and alongside incredible benefits to science and medicine, there is a real possibility that knowledge barriers preventing bad actors from obtaining biological weapons will erode. Congress must act on synthetic DNA screening.

posts.text: IBM continues to invest in enterprise AI and hybrid cloud. The agentic AI era will transform how businesses operate — from autonomous IT operations to AI-powered customer service. We're building the infrastructure to make this real.
posts.caption: IBM continues to invest in enterprise AI and hybrid cloud. The agentic AI era will transform how businesses operate — from autonomous IT operations to AI-powered customer service. We're building the infrastructure to make this real.

posts.text: Adobe's AI-powered creative tools are redefining content creation. Firefly and our generative AI models are empowering millions of creators worldwide. The future of creativity is AI-augmented, not AI-replaced.
posts.caption: Adobe's AI-powered creative tools are redefining content creation. Firefly and our generative AI models are empowering millions of creators worldwide. The future of creativity is AI-augmented, not AI-replaced.

posts.text: The AI startup ecosystem is thriving. Building technology that scales requires deep engineering and relentless focus on the user. The next generation of AI companies will be defined by how well they serve real human needs.
posts.caption: The AI startup ecosystem is thriving. Building technology that scales requires deep engineering and relentless focus on the user. The next generation of AI companies will be defined by how well they serve real human needs.

posts.text: At Chanel, we continue to blend timeless craftsmanship with innovation. Leadership today requires embracing AI and technology while preserving the human touch that defines luxury and authenticity.
posts.caption: At Chanel, we continue to blend timeless craftsmanship with innovation. Leadership today requires embracing AI and technology while preserving the human touch that defines luxury and authenticity.

posts.text: FedEx is leveraging AI across our logistics network to drive efficiency and deliver smarter. From autonomous delivery to predictive analytics, technology is transforming how we connect the world.
posts.caption: FedEx is leveraging AI across our logistics network to drive efficiency and deliver smarter. From autonomous delivery to predictive analytics, technology is transforming how we connect the world.

posts.text: Back-to-back IPL titles with RCB — this one was special. Scored 75* in the final despite a hamstring injury. Now focusing on recovery and rehabilitation. Will miss the Afghanistan ODIs but targeting the England tour in July.
posts.caption: Back-to-back IPL titles with RCB — this one was special. Scored 75* in the final despite a hamstring injury. Now focusing on recovery and rehabilitation. Will miss the Afghanistan ODIs but targeting the England tour in July.

posts.text: Working on my fitness at the Centre of Excellence in Bengaluru. The hamstring needs proper recovery. My participation in the Afghanistan ODI series is subject to fitness clearance. Looking forward to getting back on the field soon.
posts.caption: Working on my fitness at the Centre of Excellence in Bengaluru. The hamstring needs proper recovery. My participation in the Afghanistan ODI series is subject to fitness clearance. Looking forward to getting back on the field soon.

posts.text: Another incredible IPL season. The tournament continues to produce world-class talent and unforgettable moments. Cricket remains the heartbeat of India.
posts.caption: Another incredible IPL season. The tournament continues to produce world-class talent and unforgettable moments. Cricket remains the heartbeat of India.

posts.text: Ready for the one-off Test against Afghanistan starting June 6 at Mohali. It's always an honour to represent India. Time to lead the attack and set the tone for a packed international summer.
posts.caption: Ready for the one-off Test against Afghanistan starting June 6 at Mohali. It's always an honour to represent India. Time to lead the attack and set the tone for a packed international summer.

posts.text: At the Centre of Excellence proving my fitness ahead of the Afghanistan ODI series. The body feels good and I'm determined to be ready. Can't wait to get back in India colours.
posts.caption: At the Centre of Excellence proving my fitness ahead of the Afghanistan ODI series. The body feels good and I'm determined to be ready. Can't wait to get back in India colours.

posts.text: Congratulations to RCB on winning back-to-back IPL titles! Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's 5 individual awards at just 15 years old is phenomenal — the future of Indian cricket is in great hands. What a season!
posts.caption: Congratulations to RCB on winning back-to-back IPL titles! Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's 5 individual awards at just 15 years old is phenomenal — the future of Indian cricket is in great hands. What a season!

posts.text: India's cricket calendar is packed — one-off Test vs Afghanistan, then ODIs, then the England tour. The depth we have now is remarkable. Managing workload while keeping the bench strong will be key.
posts.caption: India's cricket calendar is packed — one-off Test vs Afghanistan, then ODIs, then the England tour. The depth we have now is remarkable. Managing workload while keeping the bench strong will be key.

posts.text: India squad for Afghanistan ODIs announced — Shubman Gill to captain. Virat Kohli ruled out due to hamstring injury. Ruturaj Gaikwad and Rajat Patidar called up as replacements. The one-off Test begins June 6 at Mohali.
posts.caption: India squad for Afghanistan ODIs announced — Shubman Gill to captain. Virat Kohli ruled out due to hamstring injury. Ruturaj Gaikwad and Rajat Patidar called up as replacements. The one-off Test begins June 6 at Mohali.

posts.text: A packed international cricket calendar ahead! India vs Afghanistan Test begins June 6, followed by ODIs. The World Test Championship race continues to heat up. Stay tuned for all the action.
posts.caption: A packed international cricket calendar ahead! India vs Afghanistan Test begins June 6, followed by ODIs. The World Test Championship race continues to heat up. Stay tuned for all the action.

posts.text: What a season IPL 2026 has been! RCB clinched back-to-back titles. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi rewrote the record books — Orange Cap (776 runs), MVP, Emerging Player, Super Striker, and Most Sixes (72, breaking Gayle's record). Simply incredible at 15!
posts.caption: What a season IPL 2026 has been! RCB clinched back-to-back titles. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi rewrote the record books — Orange Cap (776 runs), MVP, Emerging Player, Super Striker, and Most Sixes (72, breaking Gayle's record). Simply incredible at 15!

posts.text: Congratulations to Rumesh Pathirage on his incredible 92.62m throw at the Rome Diamond League — what a performance! Competition in Asian javelin is growing stronger. I'm preparing for the Golden Spike meet in Ostrava on June 24, then the Neeraj Chopra Classic on July 5.
posts.caption: Congratulations to Rumesh Pathirage on his incredible 92.62m throw at the Rome Diamond League — what a performance! Competition in Asian javelin is growing stronger. I'm preparing for the Golden Spike meet in Ostrava on June 24, then the Neeraj Chopra Classic on July 5.

posts.text: Training hard and staying focused for the upcoming tournaments. Every day on the court is a step closer to the goals I've set. The Asian Games preparation is in full swing.
posts.caption: Training hard and staying focused for the upcoming tournaments. Every day on the court is a step closer to the goals I've set. The Asian Games preparation is in full swing.

posts.text: Indian sport continues to break barriers. From cricket to javelin to badminton — our athletes are competing at the highest level on the world stage. The next generation is ready to carry the torch forward.
posts.caption: Indian sport continues to break barriers. From cricket to javelin to badminton — our athletes are competing at the highest level on the world stage. The next generation is ready to carry the torch forward.

posts.text: Continuing my preparations for the upcoming chess season. As World Chess Champion, every tournament is a new challenge. The board never gets easier — that's what makes it beautiful.
posts.caption: Continuing my preparations for the upcoming chess season. As World Chess Champion, every tournament is a new challenge. The board never gets easier — that's what makes it beautiful.

posts.text: Indian football continues to grow. The grassroots development and academy system is producing talented players who can compete internationally. Proud of how far the beautiful game has come in India.
posts.caption: Indian football continues to grow. The grassroots development and academy system is producing talented players who can compete internationally. Proud of how far the beautiful game has come in India.
